name: Swift-Daley House

dates.altered: Restored to what its owners called its original condition by Mr and Mrs Raymond Daley after 1939; given to the Eastham Historical Society in 1974 (Cape Cod Museum Trail).
dates.note: The Eastham Historical Society, which owns it, gives 1741 and names Joshua Knowles as builder.

refs.title: 1741 Swift-Daley House
refs.note: Owner. 'Built in 1741 by Joshua Knowles, its bowed roof is typical of early houses built by ship's carpenters.'

refs.title: Eastham Historical Society | Cape Cod Museum Trail
refs.note: Gives the address as 2375 State Highway, Eastham, and the later history: occupied in 1859 by the butcher Nathaniel Swift, restored by the Daleys from 1939, donated 1974.

note: No register reference and no HABS survey were found; the search '"Swift-Daley House" Eastham Massachusetts Cape Cod house 1741' returned the owner's and the museum trail's pages and no loc.gov or nps.gov item.
